headline: Shipbuilding growth drives a profit beat, cash draws down
summary_short: Revenue rose 10.9% y/y to $3.42B on higher shipbuilding volumes at Newport News and Ingalls, while diluted EPS climbed 36.5% y/y to $5.27 as operating income improved across all three segments and total cash fell to $12M from $216M last quarter.
summary_long: Newport News revenue grew 15% y/y to $1.85B on higher carrier and submarine volumes plus contract incentives; segment operating income rose 35% to $111M. Ingalls revenue grew 17% to $845M on higher amphibious-ship volumes; operating income rose 7% to $58M. Mission Technologies revenue fell 4% to $760M on lower All-Domain and Global Security volumes, but operating income rose to $55M from $36M on higher JV equity income. Consolidated operating income rose 29% y/y to $210M; diluted EPS rose 36.5% to $5.27. Six-month operating cash flow swung to a $421M use on working-capital timing, pulling cash to $12M; long-term debt held flat near $2.70B; equity grew to $5.31B. Backlog reached $57.3B; FY2026 capex guided to 1.0%-1.5% plus 3.0%-3.5% of revenue.
